Job documentation tools for Remodelers & carpenters

Tools that help remodelers & carpenters with job documentation. Site photos, daily reports, progress tracking and proof of work for clients and compliance.

Where Job documentation goes wrong for Remodelers & carpenters

Daily progress photos and signed change orders are what protect a remodeller when scope is questioned. Most remodelling disputes come down to what was agreed and when.

What Remodelers & carpenters jobs really involve

Remodelling jobs run for weeks, involve change orders and tie up cash in materials before the customer pays. Job costing and progress billing are the difference between a profitable project and one that quietly loses money.

Frequently asked questions

Which job documentation tools work best for remodelers & carpenters?

The three that fit best here are Knowify (Contractors who need to know whether a job actually made money), Contractor Foreman (Small contractors who want one system instead of five spreadsheets), CompanyCam (Any trade that needs proof of what was done and when). Start with the one whose description matches your crew size, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does job documentation software cost for remodelers & carpenters?

Across the 10 tools on this page, 4 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices change often, so treat the figures here as indicative and confirm on the vendor site.

Why does job documentation cause problems for remodelers & carpenters specifically?

Daily progress photos and signed change orders are what protect a remodeller when scope is questioned. Most remodelling disputes come down to what was agreed and when.

How do I stop change orders eating the margin?

Price every change as a separate written order with its own cost and time impact before the work proceeds. Verbal changes agreed on site are where remodelling profit disappears.
